## Adaptations

- One skill for every client. The body is `graphify/skill.md` (the Claude Code and Copilot variant); Step B2's subagent dispatch text moved to `families/claude.md` (from `graphify/skill.md`, also used for Copilot because `graphify/skill-copilot.md` has the same bytes) and `families/agents.md` (from `graphify/skill-agents.md`), and each client renders its family as `references/dispatch.md`. Cursor and Codex share the agents family; the upstream Codex variant `graphify/skill-codex.md` is not used.
- The body keeps the Claude Code wording of the extraction-spec pointer in Part B ("frontmatter, hyperedge"); the agents variant omits "frontmatter". The extraction spec itself is the same for both.
- Step 1 no longer installs anything: the `uv tool install --upgrade graphifyy` step, the `pip install graphifyy` and `--break-system-packages` fallbacks and the `uv tool run --from graphifyy` probe are replaced by a check that `graphify` is on `PATH` and that its interpreter imports it; otherwise the skill tells the user to run Orqlet's install step in a terminal.
- No model backend: the backend tip, the check of two provider API-key variables, the backend code path, the default backend model name and the list of provider keys are removed; semantic extraction is the host agent's.
- `references/hooks.md` is not shipped, and the body section "For the commit hook and native CLAUDE.md integration" that links it (the post-commit hook and `graphify claude install` / `graphify agents install` registrations) is removed (ledger Q-51).
- The seven other references ship once for every client, from the agents variant (ledger Q-52). `references/github-and-merge.md` drops the comment line that suggests a `--backend` value by the API key that is set; `references/add-watch.md` drops the `pip install 'graphifyy[video]'` requirement note.
- The front matter `description` is one unquoted line, as Orqlet's skill loader reads it; the `description` is reworded so that it needs no YAML quoting: colons, double quotes, backticks and dashes become plain punctuation or single quotes, with the same meaning.
